data.gender_notes: Mehvisha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'meh' which means 'might' or 'power' and 'vasha' which means 'grace'. In the Bible, Mehvisha is associated with God's grace and power. The name Mehvisha carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mehvisha usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mehvisha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehvisha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: מְחוּשָׁה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מְחוּשָׁה היא שם האם המייצג את אופי חברתי וחברתי, אך בעבר כונו את האם המזדקנה גם כ 'מְחוּשָׁה' שהיא תואר נטוש בעל אסוציאציה של גבריות ובעל חיים (Genesis 38:6)

in_greek.name: Μεχβίσχα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα Μεχβίσχα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη מְחוּשָׁה, που σημαίνει καλή και σεμνή και φιλόσοφη (1 Πτέρων 1:9). Στη Βίβλο, ο όρος χρησιμεύει για να περιγράψει την ηλικιωμένη γυναίκα (Genesis 38:6)

in_latin.name: Mehvischa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mehvischa originatur a verbo Hebraico mēchušā, quae significat bona et sancta et sapientia (1 Paralipomenon 1:9). In Bibliis, verbum utitur ad describendum matrem senilem (Genesis 38:6)

in_english.name: Mehvisha
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mehvisha originates from the Hebrew word mēchušā, which means good and blessed and wise (1 Chronicles 1:9). In the Bible, the term is used to describe an elderly woman (Genesis 38:6). In Christian tradition, Mehvisha symbolizes virtues of kindness, compassion and wisdom.
